mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the routes was most worthwhile because it connected the sensors to a familiar result: keeping your eyes on a point while your head turns.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the two sensors to the incoming nerves was clear but a little repetitive; both results mainly showed fibres leading toward the brain.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the weighted sensors respond to changes in straight-line movement as well as tilt.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures showed where the parts belonged, though I followed the nerve-route pictures without knowing the detailed brain connections.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing the sensor parts connect to an everyday action was interesting, even if some joining steps felt repetitive.
